content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto involves using a sovereign digital commerce stack that eliminates middlemen and high fees. Traditional platforms often take significant cuts of your sales, limiting your earnings. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can quickly add up. By using a solution like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, you retain considerably more of your revenue. This approach is crucial for digital creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment platforms, allowing them to maintain autonomy over their sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components working together seamlessly. You host your sales page with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, enabling free and reliable hosting. For backend logic, you can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which allows for automated order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets can be employed for order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handles file delivery. Integrating NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment verification, providing a streamlined, efficient system that requires no KYC and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture ensures you have total control over your sales process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where major payment platforms are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this system empowers you to sell directly to your audience without incurring exorbitant fees. By choosing this architecture, you are not only gaining access to a sustainable income model but also ensuring that you have complete ownership over your products and customer data. This is a game changer for anyone looking to monetize their digital products effectively.
Retain more profit by using NOWPayments — only 0.5% transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this selling system include a hosting solution (like GitHub Pages), a backend logic processor (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), and a database for order management (Supabase or Google Sheets). Additionally, file delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly. Integrating NOWPayments for payment processing ties everything together, allowing you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This combination creates a powerful, decentralized commerce solution that enables you to manage your sales independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this system, start by selecting your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order data, then configure your file delivery method using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This process allows you to deploy your digital store quickly and efficiently. For those looking for an all-in-one solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Complete control over your digital products with no platform dependencies.

Set up your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Select a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Launch your digital store and start selling your products directly.
